mods.description: Toggle the real vanilla Blindness (or Darkness) effect on yourself, client-side only, without the sprint or swim penalty. Entirely local, no server involvement.

releases.notes:
Renamed to **Blindfold**. Same mod: toggle the real vanilla Blindness (or Warden Darkness) effect on yourself, client-side, with no sprint or swim penalty. Fully local.

Heads-up: as part of the rename the mod id, the command (now `/blindfold`), and the config file (`config/blindfold.json`) changed. If you ran a pre-1.2.0 build, you can delete the old `config/localblindness.json`.

**Requirements:** Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.19.2+, Fabric API (0.141.4+1.21.11 or newer), Java 21+.
**Install:** drop `blindfold-1.2.0.jar` and Fabric API into your `mods/` folder.

mods.name: Local Blindness
mods.description: Toggle the real vanilla Blindness (or Darkness) effect on yourself, client-side only, without the sprint penalty. Entirely local, no server involvement.

releases.notes:
Keeps the visual blindness (or darkness) but removes the sprint penalty that vanilla Blindness imposes. A small client mixin redirects the `hasBlindnessEffect()` check inside `ClientPlayerEntity.canSprint` while the mod's effect is active, so you sprint normally. The fog and darkening are unchanged, and real gameplay blindness is unaffected when the toggle is off.

**Requirements:** Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.19.2+, Fabric API (0.141.4+1.21.11 or newer), Java 21+.

**Install:** drop `localblindness-1.1.1.jar` and Fabric API into your `mods/` folder.

Built and tested on GitHub Actions.

mods.name: Local Blindness
mods.description: Toggle the real vanilla Blindness (or Darkness) effect on yourself, client-side only. Entirely local, no server involvement.

releases.notes:
Applies the **real** vanilla Blindness (or Darkness) effect to your own player, client-side only, and re-asserts it every client tick so the server's effect sync cannot strip it. This replaces the v1.0.0 screen overlay with the genuine effect, so you get the actual blindness fog and darkening.

**Requirements:** Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.19.2+, Fabric API (0.141.4+1.21.11 or newer), Java 21+.

**Install:** drop `localblindness-1.1.0.jar` and Fabric API into your `mods/` folder.

**Usage:** toggle with the `B` keybind (rebindable in Controls) or `/localblindness` (`toggle` | `on` | `off` | `style blindness|darkness` | `reload`). Style, default keybind, and icon visibility live in `config/localblindness.json`.

Built and tested on GitHub Actions (9 unit tests green).
